label: First Author
description: Extract only the surname of the first author.

label: Year of Publication
description: Extract the four-digit calendar year the study was published.

label: DOI
description: Extract the permanent Digital Object Identifier string.

label: Journal Name
description: Extract the full official name of the publishing journal.

label: Title
description: Extract the full formal title of the study.

label: Type of Study
description: Extract the author's stated study design

label: Main AI Use
description: Classify the primary operational role of AI in the workflow. Suggested classes: Triage / Pre-read Prioritization, Independent Reader / Autonomous Filter, Second Reader in Double Reading, Concurrent Decision Support / CAD, Reader Arbitration / Tie-Breaker, Standalone Diagnostic Evaluation, or other.

label: Task
description: Classify the computational task performed by AI. Suggested classes: Binary Classification (Normal vs Abnormal), Multi-class Classification, Risk Stratification / Score, Detection / Lesion Localisation, Segmentation, BI-RADS Category Assignment, or other.

label: Clinical Care Setting
description: Describe the clinical environment where the study was conducted. Suggested classes: Population-based Asymptomatic Screening, Symptomatic Assessment Clinic, Rapid Diagnostic Unit, High-Risk Surveillance, Mixed / Outpatient Clinic, or other.

label: Centre Structure
description: Extract whether single-centre or multi-centre, including the count and types of sites. Suggested classes: Single-centre or Multi-centre and exact count.

label: External Validation
description: Extract whether the AI system was validated on an external independent cohort.

label: Number of Cases
description: Extract the total count of distinct patients.

label: Number of Images/Videos
description: Extract the total number of distinct images, projections (e.g. 2-view, 4-view), slices, or video recordings evaluated.

label: Number of Normal/Benign
description: Extract the count of confirmed benign, normal, or disease-negative cases.

label: Number of Malignant
description: Extract the count of confirmed malignant/cancer cases in the cohort.

label: Age (Range, Median, Average)
description: Extract reported participant age metrics (mean, standard deviation, median, IQR, or range).

label: Lesion Size (Range, Median, Average)
description: Extract reported pathological or radiological tumor/lesion sizes (mean, median, range in mm or cm).

label: Density Measure
description: Extract the breast density classification system (e.g., BI-RADS A/B/C/D, Dense vs Non-dense) AND the exact distribution breakdown with counts and percentages (%) across the cohort or comparator groups (e.g., BI-RADS A: n (%), B: n (%), C: n (%), D: n (%)).

label: Ethnicity
description: Extract demographic breakdown of race, ethnicity, or genetic ancestry, or state if not reported.

label: Recruitment Dates
description: Extract the exact start and end dates or date range during which patients were enrolled or images were captured.

label: Country
description: Extract the country, countries, or geographic jurisdictions where clinical recruitment or data collection occurred.

label: Inclusion Criteria
description: Extract the verbatim or direct list of patient/examination inclusion criteria detailing eligibility.

label: Exclusion Criteria
description: Extract the verbatim or direct list of patient/examination exclusion criteria.

label: Selected Cases / Consecutive Cohort
description: Classify the cohort sampling method. Suggested classes: Consecutive Cohort, Random Sample, Enriched / Case-Control Sample, Convenience Sample, Retrospective Filtered Sample, or other.

label: Benign/Normal (Negative)
description: Extract the criteria used to definitively establish benign or normal status (e.g. biopsy, consensus, 1-year follow-up, 2-year cancer registry linkage).

label: Malignant (Positive)
description: Extract the criteria used to definitively verify breast cancer malignancy (e.g. histopathological verification from core-needle biopsy or surgical resection).

label: Number/Distribution of Tumour Types
description: Extract the exact counts, numbers, and percentage distributions (%) of all reported tumor types, histopathology categories, and tumor grades (e.g., Invasive Ductal Carcinoma: n (%), Invasive Lobular: n (%), DCIS / Non-invasive: n (%), Grade 1/2/3: n (%), receptor subtypes).

label: Follow-up Duration
description: Extract the explicit follow-up duration (in months or years) used to confirm reference standard or monitor interval cancers.

label: Modality
description: Classify breast imaging modality examined in the study. Suggested classes: 2D Full-Field Digital Mammography (FFDM), Digital Breast Tomosynthesis (DBT / 3D), Handheld Ultrasound (HHUS), Automated Breast Ultrasound (ABUS), Dynamic Contrast-Enhanced MRI (DCE-MRI), Whole-Slide Digital Pathology, Contrast-Enhanced Mammography (CEM), Multimodal / Combination, or other.

label: Scanner & Vendor Specs
description: Extract hardware manufacturers, specific scanner models, detector types, and acquisition parameters across participating sites.

label: Image Type
description: Extract format and image representation. Suggested classes: Processed / 'For Presentation' DICOM, Raw / 'For Processing' DICOM, Screen captures / JPEGs, Volumetric reconstructions, or other.

label: Data Split Partitioning (Randomisation)
description: Describe train/tune/test data partitioning, patient-level leakage prevention, and randomization method.

label: Name, Version
description: Extract the software trade name and algorithm release/version.

label: Vendor
description: Extract the developing entity (commercial company, startup, or academic research laboratory).

label: AI Technique / Architecture
description: Extract the deep learning / AI architecture (e.g. CNN, ResNet, Vision Transformer (ViT), Ensemble, Foundation Model, U-Net).

label: Threshold Set
description: Extract the numerical cut-off score, classification threshold, or operating score applied.

label: Threshold Determination
description: Describe how the decision threshold was established. Suggested classes: Pre-specified / Manufacturer Fixed, Calibrated on Independent Tuning Set, Post-hoc Selected on Evaluation Set (Overfitting Risk), Operating Point Matching Clinician Sensitivity/Specificity, or other.

label: Data Used for AI Training
description: Extract details regarding datasets, case numbers, and populations used to train and optimize the AI model.

label: Commercial Availability
description: Classify the commercial status of the software. Suggested classes: Commercially Available Product, CE-marked / FDA-cleared Commercial System, Research Prototype / In-House Model, Open-Source Model, or other.

label: Regulatory Approval
description: Extract regulatory authorizations held by the software. Suggested classes: FDA 510(k) Cleared, FDA PMA Approved, CE Mark (EU MDR/MDD), PMDA Approved, Investigational Use Only (IUO), No Regulatory Clearance, or other.

label: Explainability
description: Extract explainability or visualization output offered to clinicians (e.g. heatmap, bounding box, attention map, suspicion score, BI-RADS-like score, none).

label: Code Availability
description: Extract whether model weights or source code are publicly accessible. Suggested classes: Publicly Available on GitHub/Repository, Available Upon Reasonable Request, Proprietary / Closed Source, Model Weights Shared on HuggingFace, or other.

label: Number of Readers
description: Extract the total number of medical practitioners / radiologists reading cases in the study.

label: Readers Experience & Qualifications
description: Extract training background, credentials, breast subspecialty status, years of clinical experience, or annual reading volume.

label: Single, Double, Multireader
description: Classify clinical reading paradigm. Suggested classes: Single Reading, Double Reading with Consensus, Independent Double Reading with Arbitration, Multi-reader (MRMC panel), Triple Reading, or other.

label: Number of Readers for Each Case
description: Extract how many distinct clinicians interpreted each individual patient case.

label: Settings (Comparator Arms)
description: Classify comparison arm setup. Suggested classes: Standalone AI vs. Unaided Clinician, AI-Assisted Clinician vs. Unaided Clinician, Standalone AI vs. AI-Assisted Clinician, AI as First Reader vs. Standard Double Reading, AI as Second Reader vs. Human Second Reader, or other.

label: Information Available to Readers
description: Describe clinical context provided to readers (e.g. prior mammograms, age, family history, symptoms, or blinded to all history).

label: How Are Discrepancies Handled
description: Describe conflict resolution when readers disagree (e.g. third senior arbitrator, consensus meeting, highest suspicion score).

label: Scoring Method Used, Version
description: Extract the scoring system used by readers and AI (e.g. BI-RADS 1-5, continuous 0-100 probability of malignancy, Likert scale).

label: Sensitivity (CI)
description: Extract reported sensitivity with 95% confidence intervals across comparator settings (AI standalone, reader alone, AI + reader).

label: Specificity (CI)
description: Extract reported specificity with 95% confidence intervals across comparator settings (AI, reader alone, AI + reader).

label: AUROC / AUC (CI)
description: Extract Area Under the ROC Curve (AUROC / AUC) with 95% confidence intervals across comparator arms (AI vs. readers vs. combined).

label: Recall
description: Extract patient recall metrics (recall rate, percentage, absolute counts/proportions of recalled patients/cancers, or concordance/discordance in recall decisions between AI and readers, or ML sensitivity/recall).

label: Detection Rate
description: Extract cancer detection rate (CDR, e.g. cancers detected per 1,000 screened women) across evaluated arms.

label: PPV
description: Extract Positive Predictive Value (PPV1, PPV2, or PPV3) across comparator settings.

label: NPV
description: Extract Negative Predictive Value (NPV) across comparator settings.

label: Workload Efficiency Impact
description: Extract quantitative reduction in reading workload or screening burden.

label: Reading Time Reduction
description: Extract impact on reader interpretation time (seconds per case or percentage reduction in time per exam).

label: Arbitration Volume
description: Extract the number, proportion, or change in cases requiring consensus arbitration or third-reader review.

label: Reads Averted
description: Extract the proportion or count of human reads averted (e.g. through AI autonomous rule-out of normal exams).

label: Downstream Clinical Outcome
description: Extract patient-relevant downstream outcomes (e.g. benign biopsies avoided, stage distribution shift, interval cancer rates, delayed diagnoses).

label: Economic Analysis
description: Extract any formal health economic findings, cost-effectiveness analysis, ICER, or cost savings.

label: Funding
description: Extract funding sources, government research grants (e.g. NIH, Horizon), or commercial sponsorship.

label: Affiliations
description: Extract institutional affiliations and academic/clinical departments of study authors.

label: Conflict of Interests
description: Extract author disclosures regarding financial conflicts, stock ownership, advisory roles, or patents with AI companies.

label: Regulatory Aspects
description: Extract discussions or statements regarding regulatory clearance, software medical device classification (SaMD), or compliance barriers.

label: Reported Limitations
description: Extract the primary limitations, confounding factors, and methodological caveats stated by the authors.

label: Reported Guideline Adherence
description: Extract adherence to reporting standards. Suggested classes: STARD-AI, TRIPOD-AI / TRIPOD+AI, CONSORT-AI, SPIRIT-AI, CLAIM, DECIDE-AI, QUADAS-2, None Reported, or other.

label: Trial Registration
description: Extract prospective clinical trial registry identifier (e.g. ClinicalTrials.gov NCT number, ISRCTN, DRKS).

label: Automation Bias Reader Behaviour
description: Extract observations on clinician cognitive bias, automation bias, anchoring on AI alerts, dismissals of true positives, or over-reliance on false alarms.

label: Technical Failures
description: Extract reported counts, percentages, or descriptions of exams rejected or failing AI processing due to software bugs, image artifacts, DICOM corruption, or anatomical variances.
